positioning: The running brand that publishes the complete, audited footprint of every shoe it makes — proof before promises, for runners who read labels the way they read splits.
pillars: Radical receipts: every material, cost and emission itemized and independently audited
Performance parity: verified against category benchmarks before any sustainability claim is made
Public accountability: misses and failures published alongside the wins
rationale: Research shows the audience is data-literate and distrustful by default; competitors either lead with vague green language (attackable) or bury their proof (forgettable). Owning verifiable transparency converts the audience's skepticism from a barrier into the buying trigger itself.
